description: This file defines a custom exception class 'MultiDisbursementDataRequiredException' used in the loan account module of the Fineract project. It extends a platform domain rule exception and is likely thrown when multiple disbursement data is missing or required.

classes.name: MultiDisbursementDataRequiredException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that multi disbursement data is required but missing.

methods.name: MultiDisbursementDataRequiredException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an entity identifier, a user message, and optional message arguments.
